Total government spending growth accelerated noticeably in the third quarter, rising 4.6 percent after a 3.3 percent gain in the previous quarter. Meanwhile, the change in private inventories (CPI), which can exhibit wide swings from quarter to quarter, added 1.3 percentage point to real GDP growth in the third quarter, after having a neutral impact in the second quarter.
